h1: Top 5 Best IAS Coaching in South Delhi 2026
metaDescription: Top 5 IAS coaching institutes in South Delhi 2026: First IAS Institute (#1), Future IAS, Analytics IAS, Bajirao IAS, and Chanakya IAS Academy — 100-point scores, fees, and official contacts.

institutes.name: First IAS Institute
institutes.blurb: First IAS Institute is the #1 IAS coaching pick in South Delhi: the Kalu Sarai / Hauz Khas classroom (47/1), established in 2009. Faculty is a verified permanent panel headed by Ashish Sir and Rahul Sir, backed by a 12-member research desk, 250+ Prelims and Mains mocks, and Current Affairs classes. Published results include 58 verified CSE selections and a large IAS, IPS, and IRS alumni base. +91-9990228268 / firstiasofficial@gmail.com.
institutes.address: 47/1, First Floor, Kalu Sarai, Hauz Khas & Old Rajinder Nagar, New Delhi 110016

institutes.name: Future IAS
institutes.blurb: Future IAS is the #2 South Delhi IAS shortlist for a smaller classroom than ORN halls. Confirm the live Satya Niketan / South Campus pin, fee card, and GST name on futureias.net before you travel or pay.
institutes.address: South Delhi / Satya Niketan corridor — confirm the live classroom pin on futureias.net

faqs.question: Which is the best IAS coaching in South Delhi in 2026?
faqs.answer: This locality ranking places First IAS Institute (Kalu Sarai / Hauz Khas) at #1, then Future IAS, Analytics IAS, Bajirao IAS, and Chanakya IAS Academy (Satyaniketan). Confirm each boutique pin before you travel.

faqs.question: Is Bajirao IAS the same as Vajirao IAS?
faqs.answer: No. Vajirao & Reddy Institute is a Shakti Nagar brand (vajiraoinstitute.com). Bajirao IAS on this South Delhi list is a different name—match the website domain and GST entity.

faqs.question: Where is Chanakya IAS Academy in South Delhi?
faqs.answer: 124, 3rd Floor, Satyaniketan, opposite Venkateshwara College, near Durgabai Deshmukh Metro Gate 1. Phone +91-9811671844.

faqs.question: Should I study in South Delhi or Old Rajinder Nagar?
faqs.answer: ORN has denser GS options (Vajiram, Vision, ForumIAS). South Delhi wins on commute from South Campus / Hauz Khas. Compare First IAS Kalu Sarai with one ORN demo in the same week.
